methods.name: New entropy estimation method for dual-polarimetric (DP) SAR data
methods.summary: A new scattering vector model for target DP information based on the reciprocity assumption, from which a new entropy is derived. It establishes an explicit mathematical relationship between the proposed DP entropy and the widely used FP entropy using matrix analysis theory.
methods.source: Liting Liang, Yunhua Zhang, Dong Li, and Xiao Dong
methods.verbatim: This article proposes a new method for estimating target polarimetric entropy from dual-polarimetric (DP) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data based on the reciprocity assumption commonly applied in the processing of full-polarimetric (FP) SAR data.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for entropy estimation is not available via any repository or persistent link.
